description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests git fast-import operations, including commits, notes, and fanout schemes for a git repository. It contains test cases for importing commits, notes, and handling of non-notes, as well as verifying fanout behavior and scope of notes updates.

methods.name: fast_import_commits
methods.description: Creates multiple commits with specified ref, appending commands to a file.

methods.name: fast_import_notes
methods.description: Creates multiple notes on commits for specified notes ref, appending commands to a file.
